Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Black and White Matted Print Wall Art of Brooklyn Bridge, Black Frame, 15" x 13"
Colors: Black
This black and white photo study of a detail of the Brooklyn Bridge is a handsome architectural piece. Matted and framed in a contemporary black frame, this piece will be at home in a modern, industrial setting. Modern black and white photo study of iconic subject On paper and encased behind glass in black finish frame; arrives ready to hang 15" x 13" Made to order
